items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But that happens every now and then. I remember when Charlie Barnet gave himself a birthday present of the Ellington band.

ctx.x: Not often. I had one other gig like that. Nat and Buddy Johnson's band, and Sarah. They -- it was a lady in Wichita Falls, Texas wanted to have a little get together for her friends, I think it was around 10 couples. So she had Nat, Buddy Johnson's band, and Sarah Vaughan to come down to this country club. And we just played for about 10, 12 people. And she said she knew her friends, her other friends were going to be furious because she didn't invite them, but she didn't want to be bothered with all those people…
But that happens every now and then. I remember when Charlie Barnet gave himself a birthday present of the Ellington band.
Sure, sure. It's not bad if you can afford it, it's not bad at all.
